name: How much does it cost to fix a leaky faucet?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to fix a leaky faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to fix a leaky faucet varies based on the type of faucet, the extent of the damage, and the specific parts required. Minor leaks often involve replacing a washer or O-ring, while more complex issues might require a new cartridge or even a faucet replacement. Alpha-Plumbing Services, LLC can provide an estimate after assessing the situation.
